title: Parse a resume into structured JSON
useCase: Paste a candidate's resume. Get back a structured record ready to paste into the candidate intake form.
body:
You are reviewing a candidate resume for GSL (EdTech, Mumbai). Extract the following into strict JSON matching the schema below. If a field is genuinely missing from the resume, use null; never fabricate. British English. Indian number formatting for any compensation figures (lakh, crore). Years of experience as a decimal number (e.g., 3.5). Do not include any commentary outside the JSON block.

Resume text:
---
{{PASTE_RESUME_HERE}}
---
inputHint: Paste the full resume text between the --- markers. Works with PDF-to-text copy or plain text.

currentRole.description: Most recent title + company, or null

expectedCtcLakhs.description: Expected annual CTC in lakh, null if not stated

title: Draft a role JD from a brief
useCase: Give Claude a one-paragraph hiring brief. Get back a structured role draft ready to paste into the New Role form.
body:
You are drafting a role posting for GSL (EdTech, Mumbai, parent Arvind Mafatlal Group). Return strict JSON matching the schema. British English. Indian context. Never use emdashes (use hyphen or colon). Responsibilities and must-haves as short bulletable lines (max ~15 words each). Focus on what the person will actually do, not generic descriptions.

Brief:
---
{{PASTE_BRIEF_HERE}}
---
inputHint: Paste a 2-5 sentence description of the role: what the person does, who they report to, must-have skills.

exampleOutputs.title: Content Lead, Secondary Science
exampleOutputs.description: Own the Grade 9-10 Science content pipeline for 10,000+ rural school students on the GSL platform.
responsibilities: Design Grade 9-10 Physics, Chemistry, and Biology curricula mapped to NCERT + CBSE
Lead a team of 3 SMEs and 2 instructional designers
Review and sign off every lesson before publish
Partner with the Ops team on rollout pacing
mustHaves: 5+ years teaching or curriculum design in Secondary Science
Deep familiarity with NCERT Grade 9-10 Science syllabus
niceToHaves: M.Sc. or Ed.D. in Science or Education
Comfort with Hindi + English bilingual content

title: Summarise interview notes into a structured feedback record
useCase: Paste your raw interview notes. Get back a structured scorecard ready to paste into the rubric form.
body:
You are summarising interview notes for a candidate at GSL. Return strict JSON. Scores use the scale given in the rubric. Keep the summary short and honest. British English. Never generic filler (no 'strong communicator' without an example).

Rubric criteria:
{{PASTE_RUBRIC_CRITERIA}}

Interview notes:
---
{{PASTE_NOTES_HERE}}
---
inputHint: Paste the rubric criteria (from the role page) followed by your raw notes from the interview.

summary.description: One paragraph, specific to this candidate

exampleOutputs.summary: Priya brought three specific examples of restructuring a Grade 9 Chemistry module after student feedback; clear ownership. Communication solid in English and Hindi. Hesitant on managing a team larger than 2.
strengths: Iterative content improvement based on student signal

title: Draft a personalised Round 1 outreach email
useCase: When the canned ROUND1-INVITE template feels too generic for a specific candidate. Paste the candidate summary + role context, get back a short email tailored to one or two specific hooks from the resume.
inputHint: Replace the {{PLACEHOLDERS}} with real values from /candidates/[id] and the role. Resume text is on the candidate record as searchableText.

openingHook.description: The single specific opener; surfaces separately so HR can sanity-check it

body.description: Full email body, ready to paste into the Emails compose flow

riskNotes.description: Any ambiguity in the resume the drafter noticed (null if none)

exampleOutputs.subject: Let's talk about Senior Content Lead at GSL
exampleOutputs.openingHook: Saw in your resume that you re-structured the Grade 9 Chemistry module at Educohire after student feedback - that kind of close-loop instinct is exactly what we need for this role.
exampleOutputs.body:
Hi Priya,

Saw in your resume that you re-structured the Grade 9 Chemistry module at Educohire after student feedback; that close-loop instinct is exactly what we need for the Senior Content Lead role at GSL.

It is a team-of-three sitting inside Academics, owning the secondary-science stack. You would be working with Manali and reporting into her on content direction.

I would love 20 minutes to talk. Any of these work for you this week: Tuesday 4:30 PM IST, Wednesday 11:00 AM IST, or Thursday 5:00 PM IST? I will send a calendar invite the moment you confirm.

Warm regards,
Shruti
hiring@getsetlearn.info
